study type: Pragmatic, superiority, 2-arm, parallel group, open, cluster randomised control trial
outcome: Antenatal detection of small for gestational age (SGA)
cohort: Pregnant women in maternity units in England
finding: The study found no effect of the Growth Assessment Protocol (GAP) on antenatal detection of SGA compared to standard care.
birth_weight: Birthweight <10th centile by both customised and population centiles
